scanNote:
WORKBOOK 12-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (51-bet, PDF 49). Yuqorida o'ngda 'Holidays with a Difference' va to'q sariq '12'.

CHAP USTUN:
5) 'Read the sentences below and match the words in bold to their opposites in the list.' Qiya: 'boring, unsuitable, disgusting, ordinary, terrible, stressful'. 1 The Riverdale Campsite is ideal for families with young children. 2 We had a fantastic time at the funfair. 3 Last year we had a very relaxing holiday. 4 I read a really interesting book last week. 5 The buildings in the city are quite extraordinary. 6 The food at that restaurant is delicious.
• 'Grammar':
6) 'Match the jobs to the places, then make sentences using who, as in the example.' 1 sailor, 2 ski instructor, 3 farmer, 4 swimming instructor, 5 diver, 6 flight attendant | a underwater, b on a ski slope, c at sea, d at a pool, e on a plane, f in the fields. Strelka: 1 → c. Qiya namuna: 'A sailor is someone who works at sea.'
7) 'Match the places to the things you can do there, then make sentences using where, as in the example.' 1 guest house, 2 dining room, 3 reception desk, 4 bathroom, 5 self-catering apartment, 6 gym | a cook your own meals, b stay when on holiday, c pay your bill, d work out, e have dinner, f have a shower. Strelka: 1 → b. Qiya namuna: 'A guest house is a place where you can stay when on holiday.'

O'NG USTUN:
8) 'Fill in the gaps with who, which or where.' MATN (astronavt surati): 'Space Camp, Florida, 1) ...... is right next to NASA's famous Kennedy Space Centre, is a place 2) ...... people can go to learn about space travel. Many activities are offered 3) ...... provide visitors with the excitement of being in space. One of the many attractions is the 'Gravity Chair', 4) ...... lets you see exactly how difficult walking in space really is! There is also a project 5) ...... gives you the chance to build your own rocket and see it take off! Camp programmes are available for children and adults 6) ...... want to experience an astronaut's life. The 'Space Habitat' is a place 7) ...... you can eat freeze-dried food and sleep in a bunk bed, just like a real astronaut! Unfortunately though, children 8) ...... are under nine years old are not allowed to take part in these programmes 9) ...... last from one to five days and cost from $550 to $875.'
9) 'Match the items in column A to the descriptions in column B, then make sentences using who, which or where, as in the example.' A: 1 sleeping bag, 2 maid, 3 stadium, 4 cooler, 5 receptionist, 6 sauna, 7 restaurant, 8 compass, 9 suncream, 10 waiter | B: a You can sit in hot steam in there. b It keeps food cold. c He serves meals. d You can enjoy a delicious meal there. e She cleans rooms. f You sleep in it when you go camping. g You can watch a football match there. h He/She welcomes guests at a hotel. i It protects your skin from the sun. j It helps you find directions. Strelka: 1 → f. Qiya namuna: 'A sleeping bag is something which you sleep in when you go camping.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '51'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the sentences below and match the words in bold to their opposites in the list: boring, unsuitable, disgusting, ordinary, terrible, stressful. 1 ideal 2 fantastic 3 relaxing 4 interesting 5 extraordinary 6 delicious
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi gaplarni o'qing va qalin harfli so'zlarni ro'yxatdagi antonimlariga moslang: boring, unsuitable, disgusting, ordinary, terrible, stressful. 1 ideal 2 fantastic 3 relaxing 4 interesting 5 extraordinary 6 delicious
exercises.explanationUz:
ANTONIMLAR (coursebook 83-bet
  5-mashq).

  ideal ↔ UNSUITABLE (nomunosib)
  fantastic ↔ TERRIBLE (dahshatli)
  relaxing ↔ STRESSFUL (asabiy)
  interesting ↔ BORING (zerikarli)
  extraordinary ↔ ORDINARY (oddiy)
  delicious ↔ DISGUSTING (jirkanch)


⚠ 'EXTRAORDINARY':

  = g'ayrioddiy, ajoyib. 'extra' +
  'ordinary'. /ɪkˈstrɔːdnri/.


⚠ 'DISGUSTING':

  = jirkanch (ovqat haqida - juda
  bemaza).


⚠ 'SELF-CATERING':

  = o'zi ovqat pishiradigan (7-
  mashq).

pairs.right: unsuitable
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ 'The campsite is ideal for families' ↔ unsuitable.

pairs.right: terrible
stressful
boring
ordinary
disgusting

exercises.instructionEn: Match the jobs to the places, then make sentences using who, as in the example. 1 sailor 2 ski instructor 3 farmer 4 swimming instructor 5 diver 6 flight attendant | a underwater b on a ski slope c at sea d at a pool e on a plane f in the fields. Example: A sailor is someone who works at sea.
exercises.instructionUz: Kasblarni joylarga moslang, so'ng who bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 sailor 2 ski instructor 3 farmer 4 swimming instructor 5 diver 6 flight attendant | a underwater b on a ski slope c at sea d at a pool e on a plane f in the fields. Namuna: Dengizchi - dengizda ishlaydigan odam.
exercises.explanationUz:
NISBIY OLMOSh 'WHO' - ODAMLAR
  (coursebook 84-bet qoidasi).

  X is someone WHO works + JOY.
  ⚠ 'who' = ... digan (odam).

  1 sailor → at sea (c)
  2 ski instructor → on a ski slope
    (b)
  3 farmer → in the fields (f)
  4 swimming instructor → at a pool
    (d)
  5 diver → underwater (a)
  6 flight attendant → on a plane
    (e)


⚠ 'A FLIGHT ATTENDANT':

  = styuard(essa).


⚠ 'AN INSTRUCTOR':

  = murabbiy, o'qituvchi.

A ski instructor is someone who works on a ski slope.
pairs.rightUz: Chang'i murabbiyi - chang'i qiyaligida ishlaydigan odam.

pairs.right: A farmer is someone who works in the fields.
A swimming instructor is someone who works at a pool.
A diver is someone who works underwater.

exercises.explanationUz:
NISBIY OLMOSh 'WHERE' - JOYLAR.

  X is a place WHERE you can + fe'l.
  ⚠ 'where' = ... digan joy.

  1 guest house → stay (b)
  2 dining room → have dinner (e)
  3 reception desk → pay your bill
    (c)
  4 bathroom → have a shower (f)
  5 self-catering apartment → cook
    your own meals (a)
  6 gym → work out (d)


⚠ 'A GUEST HOUSE':

  = mehmon uyi (kichik mehmonxona).


⚠ 'SELF-CATERING':

  = o'zi ovqat pishiradigan
  (oshxonali).


⚠ 'A RECEPTION DESK':

  = qabulxona stoli.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with who, which or where. (Space Camp, Florida)
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni who, which yoki where bilan to'ldiring. (Kosmik lager, Florida)
exercises.explanationUz:
WHO / WHICH / WHERE (coursebook
  84-bet qoidasi).

  WHO - ODAM: people who, children
    who
  WHICH - NARSA: Space Camp which,
    activities which, chair which,
    project which, programmes which
  WHERE - JOY (u yerda): a place
    where, the Space Habitat is a
    place where

  ⚠ 'a place WHERE you can go' -
  joy ichida ish.
  ⚠ 'Space Camp, WHICH is next to'
  - joy haqida ma'lumot (ega
  sifatida) → which.


⚠ SPACE CAMP:

  = AQShdagi bolalar uchun kosmik
  lager (haqiqiy, Kennedy Space
  Center yonida).


⚠ 'FREEZE-DRIED FOOD':

  = muzlatib quritilgan ovqat
  (astronavtlar uchun).


⚠ 'A BUNK BED':

  = ikki qavatli karavot.


⚠ 'TO TAKE OFF':

  = uchmoq (raketa, samolyot).


⚠ 'GRAVITY':

  = tortishish kuchi.

items.textEn: Space Camp, Florida, ___ is right next to NASA's famous Kennedy Space Centre,
is a place ___ people can go to learn about space travel.
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'a place where people can go' → where.

items.textEn: Many activities are offered ___ provide visitors with the excitement of being in space.
One of the many attractions is the 'Gravity Chair', ___ lets you see exactly how difficult walking in space really is!
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'the Gravity Chair, which lets you' → which.

items.textEn: There is also a project ___ gives you the chance to build your own rocket and see it take off!
Camp programmes are available for children and adults ___ want to experience an astronaut's life.
The 'Space Habitat' is a place ___ you can eat freeze-dried food and sleep in a bunk bed, just like a real astronaut!
items.whyUz: ⚠ 'a place where you can eat' → where.

items.textEn: Unfortunately though, children ___ are under nine years old are not allowed to take part in these programmes
___ last from one to five days and cost from $550 to $875.

exercises.instructionUz: A ustundagi bandlarni B ustundagi tavsiflarga moslang, so'ng who, which yoki where bilan gaplar tuzing, namunadagidek. 1 sleeping bag 2 maid 3 stadium 4 cooler 5 receptionist 6 sauna 7 restaurant 8 compass 9 suncream 10 waiter | a-j tavsiflar. Namuna: Uxlash xaltasi - lagerga borganda ichida uxlaydigan narsa.
exercises.explanationUz:
TA'RIFLASh - WHO / WHICH / WHERE.

  ODAM → someone WHO:
    maid (e), receptionist (h),
    waiter (c)
  NARSA → something WHICH:
    sleeping bag (f), cooler (b),
    compass (j), suncream (i)
  JOY → a place WHERE:
    stadium (g), sauna (a),
    restaurant (d)


⚠ 'A MAID':

  = xizmatchi ayol (mehmonxonada
  xona tozalovchi).


⚠ 'A COOLER':

  = sovutgich quti (piknik uchun).


⚠ 'A COMPASS':

  = kompas.


⚠ 'HOT STEAM':

  = issiq bug' (sauna).
